examples.english: When I was in high school, I got my first boyfriend/girlfriend, and we used to walk home together every day.

notes:
{恋人|こいびと} refers to a romantic partner. It is gender-neutral and slightly more literary or formal than {彼氏|かれし}/{彼女|かのじょ}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {恋人|こいびと}ができる: to get a boyfriend/girlfriend
- {恋人|こいびと}と{別|わか}れる: to break up with one's partner
- {恋人|こいびと}{同士|どうし}: as a couple, between lovers
- {恋人|こいびと}{募集|ぼしゅう}: seeking a partner (in ads)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {彼氏|かれし}: boyfriend (casual, everyday)
- {彼女|かのじょ}: girlfriend (casual, everyday)
- パートナー: partner (modern, gender-neutral)
- {愛人|あいじん}: lover (implies extramarital or secret relationship — do not confuse with {恋人|こいびと})

REGISTER:
Used in both spoken and written Japanese. In casual conversation, {彼氏|かれし}/{彼女|かのじょ} is more common; {恋人|こいびと} has a slightly romantic or literary feel.
